title: Hunt Globally: Deep Research AI Agents for Drug Asset Scouting in Investing, Business Development, and Search & Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a 'Completeness Benchmark' backward from independently observed, real-world drug program records rather than forward from agent-generated queries, preventing the systematic overrepresentation of easily discoverable assets.

Evaluating agents on a dataset of predominantly non-US regional drug assets sourced from non-English ecosystems to measure their ability to overcome the tendency of unconstrained web discovery to overweight English/US-centric announcements.

Filtering out globally amplified assets (e.g., those with major US trade press or large-pharma deal coverage) and testing agents using entity-agnostic query templates to measure the discovery of under-the-radar, previously unseen programs.
